from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u028/system/state/workspace/programs/task-44eef5cb.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The contiguous multicolor object is the horizontal stamp to copy.
    runs = []
    for r, row in enumerate(g):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == bg:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != bg:
                c += 1
            if c - start >= 2:
                runs.append((c - start, r, start, row[start:c]))
    _, _, _, stamp = max(runs)
    stamp = list(stamp)
    stamp_colors = set(stamp)
    markers = [(r, c, v) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row)
               if v != bg and v not in stamp_colors]
    for r, c, v in markers:
        start = c - len(stamp) // 2
        for j, color in enumerate(stamp):
            if 0 <= start + j < w:
                g[r][start + j] = color
    return g
'''
